Discover more Discover all destinations English English 日本語 Español عربي Culinary Experiences Journeys Wellness Dining Culture Celebrations & Events Active Adventure Jet Expeditions Yachts Overview Arva Akari Nura Culinary Experiences Savour the Spirit of a Destination Rooted in locality, Aman's culinary experiences transcend the traditional notion of dining, bringing a sense of place into every gastronomic encounter. Through conscious sourcing and growing of ingredients, a dedication to upholding culturally significant cooking techniques, and showcasing recipes and tableside rituals passed down through generations, each experience has the power to educate, uplift, and transform while nourishing body, mind and spirit. Taking food and drink far beyond its role as sustenance, Aman's culinary experiences, tastings and masterclasses span the authentic to the rare, anchored in seasonality yet truly one- of-a-kind in nature. FEATURED CULINARY EXPERIENCES AMAN KYOTO, JAPAN Tea House Senkutsu The Japanese tea ceremony, or chanoyu, embodies omotenashi, the Japanese art of hospitality. Within Tea House Senkutsu, a serene and immersive ritual unfolds, where the scent of fresh tatami, the quiet simmer of steam and the gentle play of light and shadow bring perfect harmony. Discover more AMANGIRI, UNITED STATES Sunset Trail Set out to a secluded spot in the desert and enjoy canapés and chilled Champagne as the sun sinks behind the mesas, casting its rose-gold glow across the ancient landscape. Discover more AMAN VENICE, ITALY Palazzo Kitchen Table The Palazzo Kitchen Table is an intimate, chef-led dining experience around an open teppanyaki-style counter that celebrates Italy’s finest seasonal ingredients. Across ten courses, executive chef Matteo Panfilio’s culinary passions are reflected in dishes that blend the best of Italian and Japanese cooking techniques. Discover more AMANPULO, THE PHILIPPINES Beach Dinner This thatched roof bamboo bar floating in crystal clear turquoise waters offers tropical tranquillity – an idyllic spot to enjoy a full picnic between swims, snorkelling and reclining on its sun decks. Discover more AMAN NAI LERT BANGKOK, THAILAND Evenings at Aman Lounge The Aman Lounge offers a collection of expertly crafted cocktails, alongside a selection of rare vintage spirits, a menu of Izakaya-style bar bites and nightly live music. Creating an inviting evening atmosphere, the lounge is an idyllic vantage point from which to watch the sun sink below the city skyline. Discover more AMANERA, DOMINICAN REPUBLIC Rum Masterclass Discover the true spirit of the Caribbean's most celebrated rums with a masterclass led by Amanera’s rummeliers. The class takes guests on a tasting tour of the Dominican Republic’s top distilleries, pairing individual rums with hand-selected organic chocolate. Discover more AMAN’S LATEST CULINARY DESTINATIONS MEXICO Amanvari Alongside signature Japanese and Italian dining venues, Sesui and Arva, Amanvari’s dining scene celebrates the vibrant flavours and seasonal bounty of Baja. At Luma, coastal traditions come to life through open-fire cooking, while The Lounge provides a laidback setting for cocktails and conversation. Discover more MONTENEGRO Aman Sveti Stefan Set across the island and mainland, Aman Sveti Stefan's dining venues celebrate the rich culinary heritage of Montenegro and the Adriatic. From beachfront lunches and poolside refreshments to refined restaurant experiences, each setting showcases seasonal ingredients, freshly caught seafood and simple, thoughtfully prepared Mediterranean cuisine.
